title: Road holding and road noise
summary: Feedback in this topic centers on confident road holding and planted driving feel, while some reviews mention intrusive road noise at higher speeds.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the car for feeling planted, effortless, and secure on the road.

negative.summary: Negative reviews focus on dissatisfaction with road holding in some cases and noticeable road noise, especially on motorways.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined examples mention both low and loud road noise as well as road holding and ride smoothing, so the direction is unclear across the sampled fragments.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are undetermined, which limits confidence in a clearer sentiment reading for this topic.
The topic mixes at least two related but distinct aspects—road holding and road noise—rather than one single coherent issue.
